metadata.description: Markdown documentation library for people and coding agents: a React viewer, a stdlib-only docs CLI and a portable skill for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Grok.

plugins.name: docs-react
plugins.description: Agents read and write a folder of Markdown docs through the docs CLI: list by topic, search, get, create with front matter, rebuild the index and bundle topics into one file for a web chat. Node stdlib, no MCP.
